sonota:wr:34.hint: 数万にのぼるほどの、非常に大きな数を表す表現です。
sonota:wr:34.answer: Tens of thousands of fans gathered outside the stadium.
sonota:wr:34.fullSentence: Tens of thousands of fans gathered outside the stadium.
sonota:wr:34.explanation: tens of thousands of ~ (何万もの~)。hundreds of, millions ofと同じ仲間。
sonota:wr:34.relatedInfo: hundreds of thousands of ~ で「数十万もの」という意味になる。

sonota:wr:35.hint: 現実的にできる限りの最大限の程度で、という意味の比較表現です。
sonota:wr:35.answer: Please finish the report as fast as possible.
sonota:wr:35.fullSentence: Please finish the report as fast as possible.
sonota:wr:35.explanation: as ~ as S can = as ~ as possible(できるだけ~)。
sonota:wr:35.relatedInfo: as soon as possible (できるだけ早く)は特によく使われる表現。

sonota:wr:36.hint: 1と半分という中途半端な数量を、通貨の単位で表す表現です。
sonota:wr:36.answer: This pen costs one dollar and a half.
sonota:wr:36.fullSentence: This pen costs one dollar and a half.
sonota:wr:36.explanation: one dollar and a half = one and a half dollars(1ドル50セント)。語順が2通りある。
sonota:wr:36.relatedInfo: one and a half hours = an hour and a half (1時間半)も同じパターン。

sonota:wr:37.hint: これから起こるかもしれない出来事を想定して、その対応を尋ねる表現です。
sonota:wr:37.answer: What if it rains during the outdoor concert?
sonota:wr:37.fullSentence: What if it rains during the outdoor concert?
sonota:wr:37.explanation: What if SV(過去形)(もし~したらどうする?)。未来の可能性についての心配や提案を表す。
sonota:wr:37.relatedInfo: What would you do if ~ よりも軽いニュアンスで使われることが多い。

sonota:wr:38.hint: 過去の出来事について、もし事情が違っていたらどうしていたかを尋ねる表現です。
sonota:wr:38.answer: What would you have done if you had known the truth earlier?
sonota:wr:38.fullSentence: What would you have done if you had known the truth earlier?
sonota:wr:38.explanation: What would you have done if S had done(もし~だったらどうしていた?)。仮定法過去完了。
sonota:wr:38.relatedInfo: 過去の事実に反する仮定にはhad + 過去分詞(過去完了)を使う。

sonota:wr:39.hint: ある望ましくない結果が起きないようにするために行動する、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:39.answer: She closed the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
sonota:wr:39.fullSentence: She closed the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
sonota:wr:39.explanation: so as not to V = in order not to V(~しないように)。notの位置に注意。
sonota:wr:39.relatedInfo: in order not to V も同じ意味で使える。

sonota:wr:40.hint: その条件が成立する場合に限ってのみ、ということを強調する表現です。
sonota:wr:40.answer: You can enter the lab only if you have a permit.
sonota:wr:40.fullSentence: You can enter the lab only if you have a permit.
sonota:wr:40.explanation: only if SV(~の場合に限って)。ifの節が満たされない限り成立しないことを強調する。
sonota:wr:40.relatedInfo: if only ~ (~でありさえすれば)は全く違う意味になるので注意。

sonota:wr:41.hint: ある望ましくない結果を避けるために、注意を払う、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:41.answer: He was careful not to wake his roommate when he came home late.
sonota:wr:41.fullSentence: He was careful not to wake his roommate when he came home late.
sonota:wr:41.explanation: be careful not to V = take care not to V(~しないように気をつける)。
sonota:wr:41.relatedInfo: take care not to V も同じ意味で使える。

sonota:wr:42.hint: 相手に、ある行動をしないようにと指示する、という意味の構文です。
sonota:wr:42.answer: The staff told him not to touch the artwork.
sonota:wr:42.fullSentence: The staff told him not to touch the artwork.
sonota:wr:42.explanation: tell 人 not to V(人に~しないように言う)。notの位置はto の直前。
sonota:wr:42.relatedInfo: ask/order 人 not to V も同じ語順パターン。

sonota:wr:43.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:43.hint: 病気や問題が急激ではなく、長期間にわたって続く様子を表す形容詞です。
sonota:wr:43.answer: Chronic stress can have a serious effect on your health.
sonota:wr:43.fullSentence: Chronic stress can have a serious effect on your health.
sonota:wr:43.explanation: chronic(慢性の)⇔ acute(急性の)。医学的な文脈でよく使われる対比語。
sonota:wr:43.relatedInfo: acuteは「急性の、鋭い」という意味で、chronicの反対語。

sonota:wr:44.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:44.hint: ヨーロッパから見て東側にある地域、東洋を指す言葉です。
sonota:wr:44.answer: Many Western artists were fascinated by the Orient in the 19th century.
sonota:wr:44.fullSentence: Many Western artists were fascinated by the Orient in the 19th century.
sonota:wr:44.explanation: Occident(西洋)⇔ Orient(東洋)。やや文学的・歴史的な表現。
sonota:wr:44.relatedInfo: Occidentalは「西洋の」、Orientalは「東洋の」という形容詞。

sonota:wr:45.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:45.hint: 言葉が持つ、辞書的な意味以外の含みやニュアンスを表す名詞です。
sonota:wr:45.answer: The word "cheap" has a negative connotation of low quality.
sonota:wr:45.fullSentence: The word "cheap" has a negative connotation of low quality.
sonota:wr:45.explanation: connotation(含意)⇔ denotation(明示的な意味)。
sonota:wr:45.relatedInfo: denotationは辞書に載っている文字通りの意味を指す。

sonota:wr:46.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:46.hint: 比喩ではなく、文字通りにそのままの意味で、ということを強調する副詞です。
sonota:wr:46.answer: He literally ran ten kilometers without stopping.
sonota:wr:46.fullSentence: He literally ran ten kilometers without stopping.
sonota:wr:46.explanation: literature(文学)/literary(文学的な)/literal(文字通りの)/literally(文字通りに)/literacy(識字力)は語源が同じ語族。
sonota:wr:46.relatedInfo: literalの名詞形はliteralness、対義語はfigurative(比喩的な)。

sonota:wr:47.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:47.hint: 事故やスポーツなどでけがをした、という意味の表現です。
sonota:wr:47.answer: She got hurt while playing basketball yesterday.
sonota:wr:47.fullSentence: She got hurt while playing basketball yesterday.
sonota:wr:47.explanation: be hurt = get hurt(けがをする)。hurtは無変化動詞(hurt-hurt-hurt)。
sonota:wr:47.relatedInfo: be injured, be woundedも似た意味で使われる受動表現。

sonota:wr:48.cat: 語彙対比・その他語彙
sonota:wr:48.hint: 表面からは気づきにくい、微妙で繊細な違いや特徴を表す名詞です。
sonota:wr:48.answer: Only a native speaker can fully grasp the subtleties of the language.
sonota:wr:48.fullSentence: Only a native speaker can fully grasp the subtleties of the language.
sonota:wr:48.explanation: subtleties(微妙な点、機微)。subtle(形容詞:微妙な)の名詞形。
sonota:wr:48.relatedInfo: nuance(ニュアンス)も似た意味で使われる語。
